courier_clue: Eldric whispers to you alone: The fever-herb waits with Liora Brightwater at the Caretaker's Lodge. Liora owes me an old kindness, so ask her plainly for help. Keep it between us.
escort_support_suffix: The lamp warden now looks to {name} for support on the way.

scenes.title: Night at the Rookhill Gate
scenes.narration: Night has settled over the Rookhill Gate. A cold bell tolls once in the chapel tower. Share the room with your companions, then bring your heroes into the story.

scenes.title: A Remedy Promised
scenes.narration: You meet Eldric in the lamp room near the Rookhill Gate. Lamp oil scents the air.
scenes.speaker: Eldric
scenes.dialogue: A child I know is ill, and only a rare white fever-herb will help. Liora holds it, but I daren't go alone.

setting.name: the lamp room near the Rookhill Gate

scenes.title: Whispers in the Dark
scenes.narration: Eldric lowers his voice and leans close, standing very straight.
scenes.speaker: Eldric
scenes.dialogue: I was told Liora would give it freely, if I can only reach her in one piece.

setting.name: the lamp room near the Rookhill Gate

scenes.title: Allies in the Dark
scenes.narration: Eldric nods, standing very straight, and stays close at your shoulder.
scenes.speaker: Eldric
scenes.dialogue: The Caretaker's Lodge. Hurry, if you can. Every hour counts, and I will not forget your kindness.

setting.name: the lamp room near the Rookhill Gate

scenes.title: Trouble at the gate
scenes.narration: You follow the commotion to the gate. The Bristling Giant Rat rears up on its haunches and hisses at the lantern light. It circles you.
scenes.rules_note: Both heroes are within 5 feet of the giant rat, and everyone fights in the open: no surprise, cover or movement. This encounter uses nonlethal melee attacks.

scenes.title: Caretaker's Lodge
scenes.narration: The lodge is small and tidy, with a kettle on the stove and keys hanging in neat rows. There, tugging at her sleeve, stands Liora, a gentle river healer.
scenes.speaker: Liora
scenes.dialogue: Yes, I owe Eldric an old kindness. Consider it paid. Now, then. Ask for me by name in any town along this route, and doors will open.

scenes.title: Breathing Room
scenes.narration: At the Caretaker's Lodge, you work out what drove the fight. It had a nest close by and took every passer-by for a threat.
scenes.rules_note: The Bristling Giant Rat falls unconscious with 1 HP. Its Short Rest has begun; campaign time has not completed it.
scenes.narration_rested: The Bristling Giant Rat was defeated. An uninterrupted hour has passed without Hit Point Dice or healing. Knocked-out creatures are awake with 1 HP, still Prone; their held weapons remain dropped. The original victory and Eldric's unresolved journey remain.
scenes.speaker: Eldric
scenes.dialogue: We are safe here. Thank you for seeing me through.

scenes.title: A Costly Encounter
scenes.narration: Liora keeps the fever-herb for now, and Eldric must try again another night.
scenes.rules_note: Both heroes are unconscious with 1 HP after nonlethal attacks. Their Short Rests have begun; campaign time has not completed them.
scenes.narration_rested: Both heroes were defeated by nonlethal attacks. An uninterrupted hour has passed without Hit Point Dice or healing. They awaken with 1 HP, still Prone, and their held weapons remain dropped. That rest does not change the original defeat.

speakers.name: Eldric
speakers.role: a weary lamp warden who asks the heroes for help

speakers.name: Liora
speakers.role: a gentle river healer, the heroes' contact at the end of the road
